findings.observation: A public-read event gate reproduced both draft and action saves committing revision 1 but returning the competing revision 2.
findings.resolution: The write returns its exact committed/idempotent revision; public save methods read that immutable history revision.

findings.observation: Deleting a committed history row and calling the exact-history reader silently reinserted the row from current state.
findings.resolution: Removed repeated backfill. Reads report absent history; writes reject disagreement between current state and immutable history.

findings.observation: Six initial seeds survived: source-byte digest, unattached due evidence, citation source hash, citation offsets/line, unpacked artifact verification, and current/history consistency.
findings.resolution: Owners added public-interface corruption and provenance cases. Domain production was already correct; all six seeds are now detected.

findings.observation: Integration review required completion to verify every draft destination, report the actual fallback path, and distinguish a historical mail revision from newer local edits.
findings.resolution: Meeting completion validates package-bound exact mail receipts and presents saved versus current local revisions.

findings.observation: Removing the selected-package version check survived the original 8 execution tests.
findings.resolution: A new SDK case saves V1, selects V2 with identical draft content, requires a V2 receipt, and proves that explicit V2 saving reuses the unchanged file.

findings.observation: Separate UI review found that identical retries reused an indistinguishable prior receipt and artifact-only receipt keys collapsed queued outcomes.
findings.resolution: DraftChange/ActionChange require an explicit attempt identity; bounded history keeps each attempt. The validator restored artifact-only keys and observed the new event-gated test fail.

findings.observation: Legacy Windows access failed at final artifact paths of 261–268 characters although the shorter staging directory could verify successfully.
findings.resolution: Filesystem effects use extended native spelling while task IDs, manifests, rendered bytes, public paths, and versions remain canonical. Native deep-directory contracts and a separate FileVerifier bypass detect removal.

findings.observation: Intermittent WinError 5 at atomic rename interrupted baseline publication; a real delete-sharing-denied directory reader reproduced WinError 32 deterministically.
findings.resolution: Classified bounded retries preserve the complete staging directory, verify a competing destination, and retain prior versions on exhaustion. Retry removal, blanket retries, and omitted WinError 5 are independently detected.
